svg.title: Through-hole lead length at fine pitch
svg.desc: Drawn to scale except copper thickness, side views through two neighboring leads of a 1.27 mm-pitch connector on a 1.6 mm board, three times. Left, marked right: the leads stick out about 1 mm and each has a full fillet. Middle, marked wrong: the leads end inside the holes, with no fillet on the solder side. Right, marked wrong: the leads stick out about 4 mm, and solder bridges between them against the board.

g.text: A full fillet round the lead
No fillet on the solder side
Drawn to scale except copper thickness.
1.27 mm pitch, 0.5 mm leads, 1.6 mm board.
